heroes.title: Aliceth - Radiant Wings
heroes.name: Aliceth
heroes.description: A Marksman who transforms her wings into a mighty bow and empowers an ally with divine power to strike enemies under her mark.

skills.name: Radiant Rain
skills.description: Aliceth flies into the air and fires 6 volleys of 3 arrows in rapid succession at an enemy. Each arrow deals 100% (ATK-based) + 10% damage, plus extra damage equal to 5% of the enemy's lost HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 50% (ATK-based). Aliceth remains invincible while airborne.

levels.text: Increases the base damage of each arrow to 105% (ATK-based) + 10%.
Increases the base damage of each arrow to 110% (ATK-based) + 10%.
Increases the base damage of each arrow to 115% (ATK-based) + 10%.
Increases the base damage of each arrow to 120% (ATK-based) + 10%.

skills.description_lite: Aliceth flies into the air and fires arrows at an enemy.

skills.name: Guiding Light
skills.description: Passive. Aliceth grants an ally Brightfeather, prioritizing the nearest ally in her row. After that, ally deals ranged damage 3 times, they unleash a feather for an additional strike, dealing 120% (ATK-based) + 20% damage. This strike can occur once every 0.5s. If the ally granted Brightfeather is a ranged unit, their normal attack range is increased by 5 tiles. The ally loses Brightfeather if they are defeated. Active. Aliceth shoots a charged arrow at enemy, dealing 380% (ATK-based) + 50% damage, knocking them back 6 tiles, and stunning them for 2.5s.

levels.text: Increases the damage of the charged arrow to 420% (ATK-based) + 50%.
Increases the damage of the charged arrow to 460% (ATK-based) + 50%.
Increases the damage of the charged arrow to 500% (ATK-based) + 50%.

skills.description_lite: Passive. Aliceth grants an ally Brightfeather, allowing them to unleash a feather strike after dealing damage a set number of times. Active. Aliceth strikes an enemy for heavy damage, knocking them back and stunning them.

skills.name: Sealed Fate
skills.description: When a battle starts, Aliceth places her Mark of Judgement on the farthest enemy. She and allies with Brightfeather both prioritize attacking the marked enemy, and their attacks against that enemy gain an extra 35 + 5 Penetration. Passive. After Aliceth locks on the same enemy for 6s or casts her Ultimte, the Mark of Judgement is enhanced. The enchanted mark allows her to instantly defeat the marked enemy if her attack reduces the enemy's HP below 300% (ATK-based) + 30%. If the marked enemy is defeated or becomes untargetable, Aliceth shifts the mark to a new enemy, resetting the mark's duration counter.

levels.text: Increases the extra Penetration applied to Aliceth and her ally's attacks against the marked enemy by 40 + 5.
Increases the extra Penetration applied to Aliceth and her ally's attacks against the marked enemy by 45 + 5.
Increases the extra Penetration applied to Aliceth and her ally's attacks against the marked enemy by 50 + 5.

skills.description_lite: Aliceth marks the farthest enemy. She and allies with Brightfeather will prioritize attacking the marked enemy.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.description: Aliceth increases her ATK by 9% in battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgement is defeated, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain an extra 6% ATK.

levels.text: Aliceth increases her ATK by 13% in battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgement is defeated or becomes untargetable, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain an extra 8% ATK.
Aliceth increases her ATK by 16% in battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgement is defeated or becomes untargetable, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain an extra 10% ATK.

skills.description_lite: Aliceth increases her ATK in battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgement is defeated, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain extra ATK.

skills.name: Aegis Wings
skills.description: The first time Aliceth or an ally with Brightfeather takes a fatal blow, Aliceth prevents their defeat. The affected hero instead becomes invincible for 1.5s and recovers 30% (HP-based). Afterward, Aliceth or the ally is moved to a safe spot within 4 tiles. But allies who are unaffected or steadfast will not be moved. This skill can trigger once per hero.

levels.text: The affected hero recovers 35% (HP-based).
The affected hero recovers 40% (HP-based).

For every 4 feather unleashed by an ally with Brightfeather, a burst of light erupts, dealing 330% (ATK-based) damage to adjacent enemies and blinding them for 3s. Blinded enemies lose 40% (ATK-based) HP per second.

skills.description_lite: The first time Aliceth or an ally with Brightfeather takes a fatal blow, Aliceth prevents their defeat.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.description: For every 4 feathers unleashed by an ally with Brightfeather, Aliceth's Radiant Rain is enhanced to fire 1 extra arrow volley for the rest of the battle. Through this, she can fire up to 6 extra arrow volleys in total.
skills.description_lite: Each time an ally with Brightfeather unleashes a set number of feathers, Aliceth's Ultimate is enhanced to fire additional volleys of arrows with each cast.

heroes.title: Alna - Frozen Mother
heroes.name: Alna
heroes.description: A stalwart Tank who summons swirling snowstorms to shield allies from incoming damage.

skills.name: Winter Anthem
skills.description: Passive. When a battle starts, Alna blankets the battlefield in frost, reducing Haste by 40 and range by 2 tiles for all units except herself. Active. Alna lets out a battle cry and summons a blizzard, which removes the Haste buffs from all enemies and deals 40% (ATK-based) + 6% damage to each enemy every 0.5s for 8s. While the blizzard is active, when Alna or the Winter Warrior takes damage, they recover 50% + 5% of the HP lost from that damage over the next 10s.

levels.text: Increases the impact damage to 45% (ATK-based) + 6%.
Increases the impact damage to 50% (ATK-based) + 6%.
Increases the impact damage to 55% (ATK-based) + 6%.
Increases the impact damage to 60% (ATK-based) + 6%.

skills.description_lite: Alna summons a blizzard to reduce enemies' Haste and deal damage over time.

skills.name: Shared Resolve
skills.description: During battle preparation, Alna selects an ally placed in the same row as herself to become the Winter Warrior. That ally is immune to Winter Anthem's Haste reduction effect, and their max HP is permanently increased by 15% + 1.5%. Active. Alna thrusts her spear to deal 340% (ATK-based) + 40% damage to enemies, restoring 100% + 10% HP to herself and the Winter Warrior.

levels.text: Increases the impact damage to 360% (ATK-based) + 40%.
Increases the impact damage to 380% (ATK-based) + 40%.
Increases the impact damage to 400% (ATK-based) + 40%.

skills.description_lite: Alna appoints a Winter Warrior and grants them buffs.

skills.name: Wild Whirl
skills.description: Alna repeatedly swings her spear, striking enemies within a 1-tile arc in front of her twice, with each hit dealing 120% (ATK-based) + 15% damage. She then sweeps her spear around, dealing 240% (ATK-based) + 30% damage to all surrounding enemies and reducing their Haste by 50 for 8s.

levels.text: Increases the damage of the first 2 strikes to 130% (ATK-based) + 15%, and the final strike to 260% (ATK-based) + 30%.
Increases the damage of the first 2 strikes to 140% (ATK-based) + 15%, and the final strike to 260% (ATK-based) + 30%.
Increases the damage of the first 2 strikes to 150% (ATK-based) + 15%, and the final strike to 260% (ATK-based) + 30%.

skills.description_lite: Alna sweeps her spear, dealing damage to nearby enemies and reducing their Haste.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.description: Reduces the damage taken by 10% during battle. For every 10s the battle lasts, the damage reduction increases by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.

levels.text: Reduces the damage taken by 14% during battle. For every 10s the battle lasts, the damage reduction increases by 5%, stacking up to 6 times.
Reduces the damage taken by 18% during battle. For every 10s the battle lasts, the damage reduction increases by 5%, stacking up to 7 times.

skills.description_lite: Reduce damage taken; damage reduction increases as the battle continues.

skills.name: Chilling Presence
skills.description: When a battle starts and every 20s thereafter, Alna envelops herself in icy winds, becoming immune to damage and control effects for 4s.

levels.text: Extends this skill's damage and control immunity to 5s.
Extends this skill's damage and control immunity to 6s.

After casting Chilling Presence, Alna also grants the Winter Warrior the same immunity effects. The first time either Alna's or the Winter Warrior's HP drops bellow 50% in battle, Chilling Presence triggers automatically for both. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per hero per battle.

skills.description_lite: Alna calls upon the protection of icy winds, becoming immune to damage and control effects.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.description: Alna and her Winter Warrior gain a 15% increase to their basic stats until one of them is defeated. The first time either of them leaves the Chilling Presence state, Alna or the Winter Warior will freeze enemies within 1 tile for 2s and reduce those enemies' Vitality by 50 for 10s.
skills.description_lite: Alna and her Winter Warrior gain a stat buff. The first time either of them leaves the Chilling Presence state, Alna or the Winter Warrior freezes nearby enemies.

heroes.title: Alsa - Desert Flare
heroes.name: Alsa
heroes.description: A graceful Mage skilled at outmaneuvering opponents.

skills.name: Twirling Rocks
skills.description: Alsa curls into a ball and moves to the target tile, dealing 300% (ATK-based) + 20% damage to adjacent enemies. Afterward, she enters Combat Stance until the battle ends. In Combat Stance, she consumes 500 Energy to cast Vigorous Slam, hitting the targets and dealing 260% (ATK-based) + 20% damage, stunning them for 2s. Alsa prioritizes Swift Evasion to deal 150% (ATK-based) + 5% damage to adjacent enemies when attacked, reducing their movement speed by 60% for 2s. Alsa rolls away from attackers afterward, gaining a shield equal to 25% of max HP for 7s. This effect occurs once every 7s at most. Alsa becomes immune to control effects when curling into a ball.

levels.text: Increases Vigorous Slam damage to 270% (ATK-based) + 20%.
Increases Vigorous Slam damage to 280% (ATK-based) + 20%.
Increases Vigorous Slam damage to 290% (ATK-based) + 20%.
Increases Vigorous Slam damage to 300% (ATK-based) + 20%.

skills.description_lite: Enters Combat Stance, gaining enhanced flexibility in dealing damage and dodging attacks.

skills.name: Stone Barrier
skills.description: Alsa channels the power of Earth Force to blast the nearest enemy target, dealing 270% (ATK-based) + 25% damage and stunning them for 2 + 0.25s. The blast creates earth pillars 3 tiles behind this target and knocks back enemies on those tiles by 1 tile. A maximum of 6 pillars can be present on the field.

levels.text: Increases damage to 280% (ATK-based) + 25%.
Increases damage to 290% (ATK-based) + 25%.
Increases damage to 300% (ATK-based) + 25%.

skills.description_lite: Alsa deals damage to an enemy and creates earth pillars on the field.

skills.name: Rolling Boulder
skills.description: Alsa senses the vibrations of leylines to locate all enemies recently affected by control effects, then drops boulders on them, dealing 250% (ATK-based) + 25% damage.

levels.text: Increases damage to 260% (ATK-based) + 25%.
Increases damage to 270% (ATK-based) + 25%.
Increases damage to 280% (ATK-based) + 25%.

skills.description_lite: Alsa deals damage to all enemies recently affected by control effects.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.description: Increases Haste by 10 during battles, gaining an extra 6 Haste after entering the Combat Stance status.

levels.text: Increases Haste by 14 during battles, gaining an extra 7 Haste after entering the Combat Stance status.
Increases Haste by 18 during battles, gaining an extra 8 Haste after entering the Combat Stance status.

skills.description_lite: Increases Haste during battle.

skills.name: Don of Terra
skills.description: Alsa increases the damage of Vigorous Slam by 50% (ATK-based) after dealing damage with the skill, stacking up to 2 times. She also increases the shield value of Swift Evasion by 5% of her max HP after casting it, stacking up to 2 times.

levels.text: Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon Level 5: Reduces the Energy cost to 400 when the Vigorous Slam buff is stacked to its maximum.

heroes.name: Aurora
heroes.description: A Celestial Mage who governs the realm of dreams and has the power to turn them into reality.

During battle, Gunnar locks onto and prioritizes attacking the enemy targeted by the ally standing on his Doomfield. Active. Gunnar deals 320% (ATK-based) + 30% damage 2 times to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target tile,then launches a Doomsday Meteor that deals 470% (ATK-based) + 50% damage to all enemies within range and sets the ground on fire for 15s. Enemies standing in the fire take 80% (ATK-based) + 8% damage every second and lose 40 Vitality. When cast automatically, Gunnar prioritizes targeting the enemy area that allows him to hit the most enemies.
